alignment_agreement.note: core.judges.SlurpIntentTokenLogprobJudge.statistics against scripts/slurp_logprob_judge_read.py::row_confidence, the read written and unit-tested before the probe flew; equality is exact, not within a tolerance

legality.definition: the row's (scenario, action) pair is not one of the 60 legal TRAIN pairs; recomputed on this arm by the predecessor read's own deterministic_judges, free and zero-latency

predecessor_whole_answer_min_token_logpr.definition: the failed primary: the minimum logprob over the WHOLE answer, at the same 86-flag budget. Reported so the successor is priced against what it replaces

schema.definition: unparsed, or an entity type outside the 55-type TRAIN vocabulary, or a repeated type; recomputed on this arm under the probe's own stricter reading, NOT the MF-9 constant

reading: DESIGN READ. The thresholds below were fixed from exactly these rows, so every precision, recall and AUROC here is measured on the data that chose the rule. None of it is quotable as a result; the decision is the fresh replicate of the LP-2 preregistration

intent_mean_token_logprob.frozen_threshold_basis: the value that flags 86 of this arm's 1,000 rows, ties at the boundary included; quoted from the predecessor verdict's successor_diagnostic_NOT_PREREGISTERED and re-derived here

precision_bootstrap.note: the flag budget is rescaled to each replicate's own size, exactly as the predecessor's own precision arm was bootstrapped
